prompt_markdown: The desk's ticket numbers must never repeat. An AI tool drafted the ticket code, and your editor shows no warnings.
Who decides that a repeated number is wrong?

options.text: The AI tool you used, because it wrote the code that makes the numbers.
You do. It is a requirement, and only you know how the desk really works.
The editor, which would warn you if two tickets ever came out the same.
Python, which refuses to run a script that gives out the same number twice.
